title: Qatar says gas export terminal blast killed 13 as workers tried to resume operations
summary: An explosion tore through Qatar’s key natural gas export terminal Sunday night as workers tried to resume operations after Iran bombed it during the war , causing a fire that killed at least 13 people and hurt dozens more.

title: Three dead in Philippines high school shooting over bullying ’grudge’
summary: Three students have been killed and more injured after two of their peers opened fire at a high school in central Philippines, police say.

title: SC to hear appeal on Minister Wijepala’s parliamentary eligibility
summary: The Supreme Court today granted special leave to appeal against a Court of Appeal ruling that dismissed a challenge to the parliamentary eligibility of Minister of Public Security Ananda Wijepala.

title: Pushpika de Silva crown removal case: Verdict scheduled for October 17
summary: Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S. Bodaragama today fixed October 17 to deliver judgment in the case concerning the alleged forcible removal of the crown from Pushpika de Silva, the winner of the Mrs. Sri Lanka 2021 pageant, causing her injuries.

title: One dead, 10 injured in multi-vehicle crash in Kegalle
summary: A woman was killed and ten others were injured following a multi-vehicle accident in the Mangalagama area of Molagoda, Kegalle today (June 22).

title: Emotional Chamari takes blame for Sri Lanka loss at T20WC
summary: Sri Lanka captain Chamari Athapaththu believes she has let her side down and missed what could be her final chance to guide them to the knockout stages of the ICC Women’s T20 World Cup.

title: Delft, Nainativu and Analaitivu set for round-the-clock power
summary: Residents of Nainativu (Nagadeepa), Analaitivu and Delft islands will soon benefit from a 24-hour uninterrupted electricity supply through a new hybrid renewable energy system currently under construction, Energy Minister Anura Karunatilaka said during an inspection tour of the project.

title: PMD responds to Daily Mirror article on Sri Lanka Cricket
summary: The President’s Media Division (PMD) has issued a statement in response to today’s Daily Mirror article titled “Hold SLC Elections or Get Blacklisted, ICC Informs President AKD.”

title: UK’s Starmer resigns as prime minister
summary: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer has resigned in a televised statement after coming under mounting pressure from his own Labour Party.

title: Rupee edges lower against US Dollar
summary: The Sri Lankan Rupee recorded a marginal depreciation against the US Dollar today (22), compared to last Friday, with the selling rate rising to Rs. 339.

title: Sri Lanka reaffirms neutral foreign policy in talks with senior US Official
summary: Foreign Affairs Minister Vijitha Herath has reaffirmed Sri Lanka’s commitment to maintaining neutrality and adhering strictly to international law during discussions with Assistant Secretary of State for South and Central Asian Affairs S. Paul Kapur.

title: Oil falls after US-Iran talks conclude in Switzerland
summary: Oil prices declined on Monday after U.S.-Iran talks concluded in Switzerland with Tehran saying it had secured waivers for oil and petrochemical exports, easing worries about a supply shortage ‌in global markets.

title: Explosion at Qatar’s Ras Laffan LNG facility injures 54, leaves 18 missing
summary: An explosion at Qatar’s main liquefied natural gas processing facility has injured 54 people and left 18 others missing, authorities have said.

title: Beware of fake PHIs extorting money
summary: The Sri Lanka Public Health Inspectors’ Union has warned the public to be alert to individuals impersonating Public Health Inspectors (PHIs) and extorting money from households and institutions under the guise of official duties.

title: Sri Lanka Army calls for applications for Officer Cadet Courses
summary: The Sri Lanka Army has invited applications for vacancies in the Officer Cadets Short Course (Diploma) and the Lady Officer Cadets Course (Diploma) in the Regular Force.
